topic: Testing AI's ability to process traffic queries
summary_markdown:
The session focused on testing the capabilities of an AI model (likely a chatbot/agent) to interpret and execute complex data queries, specifically regarding traffic analytics. Initial tests revealed difficulties with parameters and identifying specific locations like airports in Brazil.

Improvements were made by explicitly providing enums/contextual information. The AI demonstrated strong performance when asked for hourly traffic over the previous week and even handled multi-step requests (e.g., requesting traffic for a city over a month, while retaining context of 'hourly' granularity).

decisions: The AI model successfully processed complex traffic queries (e.g., hourly/weekly/monthly data).
Support for session context retention was planned to ensure the AI remembers granularity (like 'hourly') across page refreshes.
A feature to provide usage examples or a helpful guide ('how can you help me?') needs to be implemented for better user adoption.
action_items: Implement session support/context retention for the chat interface.
Develop and integrate a 'How can you help me?' response with multiple usage examples for the AI agent.
Monitor and log all user queries and AI responses into a PostgreSQL database (agent chat history) to gather insights on user needs.
